user_selection: first 5000 user IDs in frozen stage-one candidate file, ascending
edges: unique train user-movie pairs with rating >= 4.0; undirected unweighted bipartite graph

ppr.score: converged PPR probability at candidate movie node

fusion: equal reciprocal rank sum of graph PPR and stage-three ALS Top10
candidate_protocol: stage-one frozen test positives plus 100 fixed negatives; ranking cutoff before each user's first test timestamp
